title: standardized service and architecture fragments

specimens.name: Standardized pressed-steel service hatch
specimens.description: Rectangular painted door in a folded frame with two identical industrial hinges and one recessed quarter-turn latch; only the hatch assembly, not a wall.

specimens.name: Stamped perforated ventilation grille
specimens.description: Uniform perforated steel grille in a folded painted frame; no fan behind it and no surrounding machine.

specimens.name: Pressed louver panel
specimens.description: Rectangular painted-steel ventilation fragment with evenly formed identical louvers; no surrounding wall.

specimens.name: Profiled-metal wall-to-roof corner fragment
specimens.description: Small local junction with factory-formed flashing, profiled sheet and cold-formed support; fragment only, not a building.

specimens.name: Modular wall-panel to C-channel connection
specimens.description: One painted/insulated panel edge attached to a galvanized cold-formed C-channel with standardized clips or bolts; local connection only.

specimens.name: Profiled roof sheet to Z-purlin connection
specimens.description: Small local roof fragment with identical industrial fasteners and a cold-formed Z support; no complete roof.

specimens.name: Standardized steel base plate on concrete plinth
specimens.description: One local column-base fragment with four identical anchor bolts on a smooth cast-concrete plinth; no full column.

specimens.name: Galvanized anti-slip grating threshold
specimens.description: Small service threshold fragment with factory grating and a folded steel edge frame; isolated fragment only.

global_forbidden: baked cast shadows or contact shadows
glow, bloom, rays or temporary FX

era_contract.character: repeatable industrial building components using pressed/folded sheet metal, standardized service access and cold-formed supports
